newsitem.title: CHINA: Champion Tech says in cooperation talks.
newsitem.headline: Champion Tech says in cooperation talks.

text.p: Champion Technology Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it was in business cooperation talks with a third party which might result in the purchase of assets.

"The company is conducting negotiations with an independent third party in respect of proposed business cooperation with the company which may involve acquisition of shares in the company and/or acquisition of assets by the company," Champion said.
"The negotiations are in preliminary stage and no agreement has been reached."
Shares of the telepaging group were up HK$0.04 at HK$1.19.
